diversity.theory: For deduplicated exact-match pools exactly one candidate is correct, so pair success events are mutually exclusive: Cov(C_i,C_j) = -p_i p_j and rho_ij = -p_i p_j / sqrt(p_i(1-p_i)p_j(1-p_j)). Substituting into U = p_i+p_j-p_i p_j-rho sqrt(p_i(1-p_i)p_j(1-p_j)) gives U = p_i+p_j, so the correlation-aware coverage rule collapses to top-2-by-p_hat; diversity cannot help unless p_hat itself is better or candidates carry per-view multiplicity.
